cases.description: A synthetic pinned DCC 3.3.0 has trusted signature coverage, verified lab scope and exact passport applicability.
The DCC is well-formed and XSD-valid but has no XML signature, which is optional in the XSD.
The DCC signature value is cryptographically invalid.
The signed reference digest is invalid.
The signer certificate is valid but the signer is outside the configured trust policy.
The signing certificate is revoked.
The document is not well-formed XML.
The document uses an unsupported DCC schema version.
The root namespace does not match the pinned PTB DCC namespace.
The bytes received differ from the retained original artifact digest.
The XML signature does not cover the calibration result consumed by the passport.
Duplicate XML IDs make reference resolution ambiguous.
The XML document contains external signature references.
A signature transform falls outside the pinned verifier policy.
A signature-wrapping ambiguity means the application may consume a different result than the signed one.
The laboratory accreditation schedule has not been independently authenticated or checked current.
The verified laboratory scope excludes the declared measurement method.
The laboratory scope range does not cover the calibration result range.
The DCC laboratory identity differs from the accredited schedule subject.
The calibration result measurand differs from the instrument passport channel.
The calibration result unit differs from the passport unit.
The certificate is replayed against a different instrument identity.
The calibration result channel does not match the passport channel.
The calibration method revision differs from the passport requirement.
The calibration range does not contain the sample observation value.
The calibration date is after the sample observation date.
The calibration due date precedes the sample observation date.
The DCC reports an out-of-tolerance calibration result.
The DCC has been superseded by a corrected certificate.
The certificate artifact rights have been revoked for the declared use.
The calibration uncertainty is absent.
The calibration uncertainty lacks a valid coverage factor.
The certificate applies to a different firmware revision.
The XML is schema-valid, but the exact XSD bytes/digest are not pinned in the verifier profile.
The schema is pinned but XML validation has not been run.
All synthetic axes align; the DCC can only be referred for independent passport review.
